classification.difficultyReason: Rearrange or convert reciprocal equations, select appropriate angles and extend solutions over two revolutions; cotangent equal to zero requires checking the quotient numerator and denominator.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2\cos\theta&=1\\\cos\theta&=\frac12\end{align*}$$
Reference angle: $\cos^{-1}(\frac12)=60^{\circ}$. Cosine is positive in quadrants I and IV.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60^{\circ},\ 300^{\circ}\\\theta&=60^{\circ}+360^{\circ}, 300^{\circ}+360^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
All solutions in the domain are $60^{\circ},\ 300^{\circ},\ 420^{\circ},\ 660^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}&=0\\\cos\theta&=0\end{align*}$$
Here $\sin\theta\ne0$. In the first revolution, $\theta=90^{\circ}$ or $270^{\circ}$.
Add $360^{\circ}$ to each solution to obtain $450^{\circ}$ and $630^{\circ}$.
All solutions in the domain are $90^{\circ},\ 270^{\circ},\ 450^{\circ},\ 630^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{align*}\operatorname{cosec}\theta&=-2\\\frac{1}{\sin\theta}&=-2\\\sin\theta&=-\frac12\end{align*}$$
Reference angle: $\sin^{-1}(\frac12)=30^{\circ}$. Sine is negative in quadrants III and IV.
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\\&\quad\text{or }360^{\circ}-30^{\circ}\\\theta&=210^{\circ},\ 330^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
Add $360^{\circ}$ to each solution. All solutions in the domain are $210^{\circ},\ 330^{\circ},\ 570^{\circ},\ 690^{\circ}$.

Reference angle:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha&=\tan^{-1}(\sqrt2-1)\\\alpha&=22.5^{\circ}\\\alpha&=22^{\circ}30'\end{align*}$$
Tangent is positive in quadrants I and III, giving $22^{\circ}30'$ and $202^{\circ}30'$ in the first revolution.
Add $360^{\circ}$ to each solution. All solutions in the domain are $22^{\circ}30',\ 202^{\circ}30',\ 382^{\circ}30',\ 562^{\circ}30'$.
